subject: geography

source.track: IGCSE · ages 14–16 · Paper 1 Physical Geography (topics 1–5), Paper 2 Human Geography (topics 6–10)

note: The syllabus divides into ten topics designed to develop understanding of both the natural and the human environment. Sustainability is considered across every topic, and each topic is taught through detailed specific examples.

program.title: Changing river environments
topics: 1.1 The main hydrological characteristics and processes which operate in rivers and drainage basins
1.2 The main landforms associated with these processes
1.3 Rivers present opportunities and hazards for people

program.title: Changing coastal environments
topics: 2.1 Physical processes that shape the coast
2.2 The main landforms associated with these processes
2.3 Coasts present opportunities and hazards for people

program.title: Changing ecosystems
topics: 3.1 Characteristics of the Antarctic ecosystem
3.2 Threats to the Antarctic ecosystem and how they can be managed
3.3 Characteristics of the tropical rainforest ecosystem
3.4 Threats to tropical rainforest ecosystems and how they can be managed

program.title: Tectonic hazards
topics: 4.1 The structure of the Earth and distribution of earthquakes and volcanoes
4.2 The processes and features associated with earthquakes and volcanoes
4.3 The impacts of tectonic hazards
4.4 Managing the impacts of tectonic hazards

program.title: Climate change
topics: 5.1 The natural and human causes of climate change
5.2 The impacts of climate change at a range of geographic scales
5.3 Responses to climate change

program.title: Changing populations
topics: 6.1 Populations grow and decline
6.2 Population structures change over time
6.3 The causes and impacts of international migration

program.title: Changing towns and cities
topics: 7.1 Where people live
7.2 Opportunities and challenges of urbanisation
7.3 The management of urban growth

program.title: Development
topics: 8.1 Measuring development
8.2 The world is developing unevenly
8.3 Achieving sustainable development

program.title: Changing economies
topics: 9.1 Changing employment structures
9.2 The impact of globalisation and the role of transnational corporations
9.3 Tourism is a growing industry

program.title: Resource provision
topics: 10.1 How food is produced
10.2 The global patterns of food supply and demand
10.3 The challenges of food supply
10.4 How our energy is produced
10.5 The global patterns of energy supply and demand
10.6 The impacts of energy production
